1. (Currently amended) A system for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: a computing device including a processor coupled to a system memory, the system memory storing instructions for execution on the processor, the instructions configured to cause the processor to: retrieve network data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain from __at least one of an edge router or a border gateway protocol table__; analyze the network data using __a machine learning model trained on historical threat data__ and identify a malicious network threat; and perform a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat __by automatically implementing at least one of null routing, access control list modification, or network isolation without human intervention__.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the network data is retrieved from an edge router, wherein the network data comprises a snapshot of traffic being routed through the edge router __and includes temporal metadata indicating when the snapshot was captured__.

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 2, further comprising a traffic measurement aggregator module logically connected to an edge router interface, wherein the network data further comprises at least one of an amount of data transceived by the edge router or a rate of data transceived by the edge router __and wherein the aggregator module performs real-time correlation of traffic patterns across multiple edge routers__.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the network data comprises data from a border gateway protocol table associated with a primary computer network's connectivity relationships with at least one secondary network __and wherein the system identifies anomalous routing patterns indicative of BGP hijacking or route leakage attacks__.

5. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to push a notification including the mitigating action for the malicious network threat to a third party device __only after the mitigating action has been executed and verified to have neutralized the threat__.

6. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to: normalize the network data to a standard format; decorate the network data with at least one tag that identifies the network activity data; store the network data in a database; weight the network data according to a threat associated with the data __using a multi-factor threat assessment algorithm__; and generate a risk score for the weighted data __that incorporates geolocation, historical reputation, and behavioral anomaly detection__.

7. (Currently amended) The system of claim 6, wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to generate the risk score by: compare a new activity at the IP address or the domain to a past activity at the IP address or the domain __using statistical deviation analysis__; determine whether the new activity fits a profile for a malicious IP address or domain __by applying machine learning classification models__; correlate the risk score with a previous malicious threat __using graph-based threat intelligence correlation__; and adjust the risk score according to the correlation __with dynamic weighting based on threat severity and confidence metrics__.

8. (Currently amended) The system of claim 7, wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to predict a network based attack according at least the risk score __by forecasting attack vectors and generating predictive threat indicators__.

9. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the mitigating action comprises at least one of a null routing the malicious network threat, adjusting an access control list (ACL) to block the malicious network threat, publishing a list identifying a bad actor committing the malicious network threat, or logically separating the IP address or domain from a network __and wherein the mitigating action is selected based on the type and severity of the identified threat__.
